Graph functions, roots, and extrema. Find derivatives and integrals. Create tables of values. Solve equations and 3D math problems. Construct and analyze polygons, circles and conics. Millions of people around the world use GeoGebra to explore and learn math and science. Come join us!

• Plot functions, equations, curves and surfaces in 2D and 3D
• Build tables of values
• Solve equations
• Find derivatives and integrals
• Explore transformations with sliders
• Get special points of functions: roots, min, max, intersections
• Analyze different types of regressions
• Create geometric constructions and 3D objects
• Measure lengths, perimeters and areas
• Create and analyze traces of points and loci
• Experience sliders, points, graphs and geometry all working together
• Investigate construction steps to get a deeper understanding
• Switch between Graphing, Geometry, CAS and 3D Calculator 
• Search for free learning activities directly from our app
• Save and share your results with students and teachers
